overview.description: Partnership Okey is a team variant of Okey where opposite players cooperate through discard signaling and shared outcome scoring.

history.origins: Okey derives from 19th-century Levant and Central Asian tile games, sharing ancestry with Rummikub and Mahjong. It stabilised in Ottoman Turkey.
timeline: 1900s: Traditional Okey rules crystallise in Ottoman social circles.
1930s: Custom wooden tiles become a luxury standard.
1970s: Plastic sets make the game ubiquitous in Turkish households.
Present: National pastime of Turkey; played in kahvehanes and online by millions.
history.evolution: The indicator tile and false-joker system distinguish Turkish Okey from other Rummy-tile games.
history.cultural: A fixture of Turkish cafÃ© culture, often played alongside tea and backgammon.

setup.players: 4 players (2-3 possible). Each uses a rack (Istaka).
setup.deck: 106 tiles: numbers 1-13 in red, yellow, green, black (8 per number); 2 unmarked false jokers. One 6-sided die.
setup.dealing: Tiles mixed face-down, stacked in 21 piles of 5. Dealer throws die twice to select indicator tile. Player to dealer's right gets 15 tiles, others 14. Play proceeds anticlockwise.

rules.objective: Be the first to form a winning hand of 14 tilesâ€”all in valid sets and runsâ€”and expose it after your discard.
rules.gameplay: 1. Indicator tile determines joker: the tile of same color and one number higher (e.g. Green 10 face-up â†’ Green 11s are jokers). False jokers represent the joker tile only. 2. Player to dealer's right discards first. 3. Each turn: draw one tile (from centre or previous player's discard) and discard one. 4. No melding until the end; first to complete a valid hand exposes it and wins. 5. Winning hand: 14 tiles in sets (3-4 same number, different colors) and/or runs (3+ consecutive same color; 1 may follow 13). Alternative: seven identical pairs.
keyRules: Joker = same color, one number higher than indicator. False jokers = only that joker tile.
Winning with a joker discard doubles opponents' point loss (gÃ¶sterme).
If the matching indicator is in hand at start, player may show it for 1 point from each opponent.

strategy.basic: Prioritise runs over groups; runs extend both ends. Don't hoard the indicator tile unless it completes a set.
strategy.intermediate: Sometimes take from the bank instead of an opponent's discard to hide your hand.
strategy.advanced: Never discard the joker unless forced. Winning by discarding the joker doubles point loss. Track discardsâ€”if three 10s of a color are gone, that 10 is useless for a group.
tips: The false joker always equals the current round's joker tile.
Watch discard piles you're allowed to see (yours and to your left).

go_out.description: Expose your 14-tile winning hand (all in valid sets and runs, or seven identical pairs) after discarding; ends the round.
go_out.constraints: Legal only when all 14 tiles form valid combinations (sets of 3-4 same number different colours, runs of 3+ consecutive same colour, or seven identical pairs).

goingOut.condition: All 14 tiles in valid sets and runs, or seven identical pairs.

edgeCases.text: First player (to dealer's right) begins by discarding only; no draw.
Winning by discarding a joker doubles point loss for opponents.
Gösterme: showing the tile matching the indicator at start scores 1 from each opponent; only before first draw.
Game ends with no score if no tiles left to draw and current player cannot win with the previous discard.

engine.handRankingSystem: Sets and runs (3-4 same number different colours, or 3+ consecutive same colour); seven identical pairs alternate win.
engine.deckDescription: 106 wooden or plastic tiles; numbers 1-13 in four colors (red, yellow, green, black), 8 of each number; 2 unmarked false jokers.
engine.suitDescription: Four colour groups (suits) are used: red, yellow, green, and black. Each numbered tile belongs to one of these colours; the two false joker tiles have no number and are used to represent the current round's joker value.
engine.rankDescription: Each colour has tiles numbered 1 through 13, with two copies of each number per colour (104 numbered tiles total). The two false joker tiles have no printed number; each round one number in one colour is designated the joker and can substitute for any tile.

notApplicableReasons.declarationMechanism: Okey uses exposed winning hand to end the round; no chips-in-fist or simultaneous reveal.

prompts.human: Draw one, discard one. Build sets and runs. The tile one number higher than the face-up indicator is wild. First to finish wins.
prompts.ai: Game: Okey. 106 tiles, 14 per player. Joker = indicator+1 same color. False jokers = joker only. Sets: 3-4 same number diff colors. Runs: 3+ consecutive same color. Seven pairs alternate win. Score: start 20, lose 2/4 per opponent win.

scoring.description: Each player starts with 20 points. Losing points when opponents win: ordinary win -2, seven pairs or joker-discard win -4, gÃ¶sterme -1.
scoring.winCondition: First team (or last players) to have two with highest scores when someone reaches 0 or below.

nullReasons.cardValues: Okey uses round-based point loss; tiles have no point values in play.
